title: Cursor: The AI-Native Code Editor
summary: An AI-powered integrated development environment built as a fork of VS Code to provide deep codebase context. It enables autonomous software engineering through cloud-based agents, multi-file editing, and real-time AI assistance.
research_notes: Credited with popularizing 'vibe coding,' where developers focus on architectural intent while autonomous agents handle end-to-end implementation.

evolution.summary: Shifted from basic autocomplete to an autonomous platform with Background Agents and Composer 2.0. Introduced proprietary coding models and automated PR reviews via BugBot. Achieved significant market dominance with over $2 billion ARR by early 2026.
